title: Add capability fallback guidance to jmap-chat-push-platform-guide.md
description: jmap-chat-wss-guide.md has a thorough Checking capabilities section with an explicit fallback ladder: if urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:websocket is absent, fall back to EventSource; if that too is absent, fall back to HTTP polling. jmap-chat-push-platform-guide.md checks for urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:push capability but says nothing about what clients should do if the capability is absent. Add guidance: if the capability is absent, fall back to standard StateChange subscriptions (RFC 8620 PushSubscription without chatPush); this means clients will receive plain StateChange events and must call Message/changes to find new messages — the same flow as the rate-limit fallback already documented in this guide.
close_reason: Added capability fallback guidance to Overview section
